name: FreeLLMAPI
short_desc: A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API that routes across free LLM providers.
author: tashfeenahmed
description: Unify free LLM providers and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints behind one API, with fallback routing and a web dashboard. Provider credentials are encrypted at rest. This single-user service is intended for trusted local access; do not expose it to the public internet.
